title: Taiwanese Fried Chicken in Kyodo
subtitle: My business partner secured an agreement with a fried chicken distributor to open a second Uber Eats delivery outlet.
html:
Extending the business from bubble tea to fried chicken

As the bubble tea trend weakened, we also faced idle staff time during parts of the day. My business partner secured an agreement with a fried chicken distributor, and we launched the Kyodo Taiwanese fried chicken operation as a second Uber Eats delivery brand.

Choosing a delivery-only model

We chose delivery only rather than opening another physical storefront. The aim was to avoid the rent burden of an additional shop while allowing staff with available capacity to support two brands.

Bubble tea and fried chicken served different purchasing occasions. The dual-brand approach was intended to broaden revenue sources and respond to declining demand for the original product category.
